OFFICIAL SYLLABUS

Unit I scope from the course handout

Constitution of alloys – solid solutions, substitutional and interstitial; phase diagrams; isomorphous, eutectic, eutectoid, peritectic and peritectoid reactions; iron–iron carbide equilibrium diagram; classification of steel and cast iron; microstructure, properties and applications.

STUDY CHECKLIST

Topics listed in the academic calendar

Use this checklist with the Unit I student-notes PDF. It follows the topic sequence in the course handout.

  • Constitution and classification of engineering alloys
  • Substitutional and interstitial solid solutions
  • Binary phase diagrams and basic interpretation
  • Isomorphous phase diagram and lever rule
  • Eutectic and eutectoid reactions
  • Peritectic and peritectoid reactions
  • Iron–iron carbide equilibrium diagram
  • Classification of steels
  • Classification of cast irons
